name: Mujhe Kyu Toda
visual_description: A bruised character with a battered expression surrounded by distressed henchmen, edited with Devendra Fadnavis's face, asking 'Mujhe kyu toda?'.
usage_context: Used when someone gets dragged into a conflict, punished unfairly, or blamed and targeted for no apparent reason.

example.top_text: Me minding my own business during a family argument

text_areas.description: Situation or context describing why someone unfairly got caught in the crossfire
